# What Vivado 2026.1 made of each design here, on xc7a100tftg256-1, from
# `FIXTURE=memarr tools/vivado-parity/lutram.sh`. `routed` is its cell count
# after routing, `params` each block RAM it left with the parameters that
# arrange it (lutram_probe.tcl), and `tile` each block RAM tile of its
# bitstream decoded through this repository's database:
# tests/fpga_xray_memarr_vivado.rs says how to read one.
